acceptance.given: Frontmatter input, including malformed or adversarial YAML/object-constructor payloads, is supplied to the Package A validator.

oracle.expected: Parsing returns parsed data for valid frontmatter or a controlled validation error for invalid input; no YAML or object constructor executes and parsing causes no host-process side effect.
forbidden: Any YAML or object constructor executes during parsing.
Parsing side effects alter the host process.
Malformed or adversarial input causes uncontrolled execution.
oracle.observable: A focused test invokes the real validator/parser with valid, malformed, and adversarial frontmatter, instruments constructor execution, and observes the parse outcome and host-process side effects.

acceptance.then: Validation exposes parsed data or a controlled error, with no arbitrary constructor execution or parsing side effects.
acceptance.when: When the real Package A validator parses supplied frontmatter, including during the focused safety test.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the focused real-validator frontmatter safety test with adversarial YAML/object-constructor input; fail if any constructor executes, a parse side effect occurs, or parsing does not yield parsed data or a controlled validation error.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Parse frontmatter into data or return a controlled validation error without executing YAML/object constructors or causing host-process side effects.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persistent state or schema changes; rollback removes the Package A validator implementation while leaving existing Skill frontmatter untouched.

slice_hint.state_transition: Supplied frontmatter is safely parsed into data or rejected with a controlled validation error; parser execution cannot alter host-process state.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The focused validator test demonstrates parsed data or a controlled error for the tested inputs and observes zero YAML/object-constructor executions and no parsing side effects.
